mechanism: Establish one original micro-scale flying carrier, one product anchor and a human-scale environment in the same frame so relative size is immediate. Maintain a continuous forward FPV route through at least three obstacle chapters that change navigation rule—such as low tabletop weave, soft environmental corridor and enclosed organic tunnel—while every chapter retains a visible exit gap. Use one repeated shape, color or opening to redirect the carrier back toward the original product geography. Decelerate before the product return, then let the carrier land or hover in a stable relation to the package before one restrained product-state effect and concise name lockup. The reusable mechanism is micro scale, continuous FPV, changing obstacle grammar, visible exits, motif-guided return, deceleration and product reunion—not the source bee, picnic, people, child, dog, foods, flowers, fruit, cans, branding, exact route, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Show one micro carrier, one product and human-scale objects together before flight.
invariants.purpose: Makes scale and terminal objective measurable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting in abstract flight loses product context.

invariants.rule: Use at least three forward obstacle chapters with different navigation rules and visible exits.
invariants.purpose: Creates progression without disorienting the route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Identical weaving becomes repetitive; hidden exits feel random.

invariants.rule: Keep carrier identity, heading logic and near-miss clearance physically continuous.
invariants.ablation_failure: Teleporting or intersecting objects breaks FPV credibility.

invariants.rule: Repeat one shape, color or opening to redirect the route toward original product geography.
invariants.purpose: Turns the return into designed recall rather than coincidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated cut back to the package breaks the journey.

invariants.rule: Decelerate, reunite carrier and product, then use one restrained effect and concise name.
invariants.purpose: Lets motion resolve into a legible commercial payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: A high-speed logo collision makes the product unreadable.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
